# SheetJoin

> Free Chrome extension for Google Sheets: join tables, schedule automatic joins, find duplicates, and analyze data with AI — no formulas needed.

## Features
- Join two Google Sheets or CSV/Excel files by matching key columns (like SQL JOIN)
- Scheduled joins: automatically re-run joins daily, weekly, or monthly
- Find and remove duplicate rows
- AI analysis: trends, anomalies, executive reports
- Works with Google Sheets and uploaded .csv, .xlsx, .xls files
- 9 languages: English, Ukrainian, German, French, Spanish, Polish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian

## Pricing
- Free: 5 analyses/day, 5 joins/day, scheduled joins
- Pro ($4/month): 50 analyses/day, 500 joins/day, deduplication, CSV/Excel upload, priority queue
